name: Stork.AI

sources.title: Stork.AI submit — step 1 of 3, URL-driven auto-built listing, $49 or badge

conditions: The $49 one-time fee is waived entirely if you place the Stork.AI badge on your site — both paths produce the identical listing
requirements: AI tool with a live site, GitHub repo, or npm package — all three work as the submission seed
No manual copywriting needed: they scrape the URL, write the copy, pick the logo, and build listings in 8 languages (EN/FR/ES/DE/JA/KO/PT/RU)
You review and edit the auto-generated listing before choosing the payment path
preparation: A single URL: product site, GitHub repo, or npm package
Badge placement ability for the free path
Review time — check the AI-generated copy/logo before confirming
workflow: Paste the tool URL/repo/package and hit 'analyze' — listing is auto-built in 8 languages
Review and edit anything that looks off
Pick a path at the end: pay $49 once (Stripe) or add the site badge for a free identical listing
Listing goes live 'within the hour' per the submit page
watchFor: Nothing is charged until you pick a path at the review step — but the free path still costs you a badge embed
Auto-generated copy across 8 locales can contain scrape errors — review each field before confirming
'Featured' slots exist as a separate, always-labeled paid product; the browse grid itself is newest-first and cannot be bought
Listings are exposed to coding agents (Cursor, Claude Code, VS Code, Windsurf, Zed) via Stork's MCP server
countsAsLive: A public listing page at stork.ai/en/<slug> (plus 7 locale twins) appearing in the /browse grid.
unknowns: Badge HTML spec and verification mechanics
Whether an account is required or the flow is session-based
Whether the badge path delays the 'live within the hour' promise pending verification
